name: ZCA_INTG_INSTANCE_DETAILS
description: This table is used to store the integration instance details.

columns.name: REQUEST_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: This column is the primary key of the table holding unique value.

columns.name: REQUEST_DETAIL_NUMBER
columns.description: This is the PUID column of the table holding unique value.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_INSTANCE_ID
columns.description: This column is a foreign key column to ZCA_INTG_INSTANCE.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_STAGE
columns.description: This column holds the value of stage of an integration such as DRAFT, ACTIVE, SUCCESS and ERROR.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: This column holds the status of instance_details such as DRAFT, ACTIVE, SUCCESS and ERROR.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_SUB_STEP
columns.description: This column holds the name of integration such as CreateQuote,RenewQuote,ReConfigure and SubmitOrder.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_LEVEL
columns.description: This column holds the level of integration.

columns.name: PARENT_REQUEST_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: This is a self reference column to REQUEST_DETAIL_ID.

columns.name: INBOUND_PAYLOAD
columns.description: This column holds inbound payload for each step.

columns.name: RESPONSE_PAYLOAD
columns.description: This column holds response payload for each step.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
